summary: Client photo-mode session object (registry inline 8, total 1592 = 0x630-byte object + 8). Built by bg3.exe+0x3C4BB80: scalar camera/session settings up to +0x50, then two embedded ls::Atmosphere objects (+0x50 and +0x340, 0x2F0 bytes each; destructor bg3.exe+0x3B7C2D0 calls ls::Atmosphere::~Atmosphere on both and DecRefs the FixedString at +0xC). seen.py show crashes on this type (probe.py survey IndexError), so live values were not usable.

fields.name: Data
fields.evidence: An embedded ls::Atmosphere (0x2F0 bytes on Windows: +0x50 .. +0x340; constructed by bg3.exe+0x3D50E60, destroyed by ls::Atmosphere::~Atmosphere in bg3.exe+0x3B7C2D0; starts with a virtual table pointer, live). Script Extender declares ls::Atmosphere in GameDefinitions/Resources.h, but the build allows no external types, so it is kept opaque here.

fields.name: Atmosphere
fields.evidence: ls::Atmosphere constructed by the creator bg3.exe+0x3C4BB80 (bg3.exe+0x3D50E60); UpdateSystemStatus copies the render view's current atmosphere (PhotoModeSystemHelper vtable +8 = GetDefaultAtmosphere) into it and then applies it with PhotoModeSystemHelper::SetAtmosphere (vtable +0x18, argument session+0x50): the atmosphere photo mode edits.

fields.name: DefaultAtmosphere
fields.evidence: Second ls::Atmosphere (+0x340 .. +0x630): UpdateSystemStatus stores the copy of the current atmosphere here first (Atmosphere::operator=(session+0x340, current)), i.e. the atmosphere to restore when photo mode ends.

second_pass: Every scalar member settled from the Windows creator bg3.exe+0x3C4BB80 and the named Toolkit UpdateSystemStatus / ProcessUIChanges, which copy the Brightness, ColorGrading, DoF, Exposure and Vignette components member by member into it. The component slot is an 8-byte POINTER to this 0x630-byte heap object (creator: ComponentFrameStorageAllocRaw(.., 8, ..) then *slot = object): the generator must declare the component as a pointer to this struct, not inline - that is why the validator saw 1584 against 8.
